comment: Settings schema (SET-7). Labels, wizard steps and descriptions of wizard fields live in setup-fields.json; this file adds the group, the description of every other setting and whether it is usually set in Compose. Every key of AutoSourcarrSettings.Definitions must appear here. compose: recommended = usually set in Compose; only = can only be set in Compose (it names container folders or identities, so a wrong value in the app could stop it from starting); allowed = normally edited in the app.

SETTINGS_CONFIG_DIR.description: Folder inside the container that holds config.json, config.key and setup state. Mount it as a persistent volume.

APP_SERVICES_MODE.description: integrated runs the bundled helper services inside this container; external keeps separately deployed helpers (0.4.x layouts).

REPAIR_WORKER_URL.description: Address of an external repair worker. Leave empty with the integrated image.

REPAIR_WORKER_TOKEN.description: Shared secret for the external repair worker. Not needed with the integrated image.

SOURCE_ENGINE_MODE.description: integrated runs sources inside this image; external uses a separate source host (rollback and development only).

SOURCE_ENGINE_UID.description: User ID the source engine runs as. 0 picks the owner of the existing source folder (TrueNAS often uses 568).

SOURCE_ENGINE_GID.description: Group ID the source engine runs as. 0 picks the group of the existing source folder.

SOURCE_SUWAYOMI_URL.description: Address of the external source host when the source engine runs in external mode.

DATA_DIR.description: Folder inside the container for covers, caches and runtime data. Mount it as a persistent volume.

DATABASE_DIR.description: Folder for the SQLite databases. Empty uses the data folder. Set it in Compose only, pointing at a mounted folder that already holds the databases; moving them from the app arrives with the new data layer (conversion phase 2).

BACKGROUND_TASK_CONCURRENCY.description: How many background tasks run at the same time.

METADATA_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long fetched metadata is kept before it is refreshed, in seconds.

METADATA_IDENTITY_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit for one metadata provider request, in seconds.

METADATA_IDENTITY_OVERALL_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit for one identity lookup across all providers, in seconds.

METADATA_IDENTITY_CONCURRENCY.description: How many identity lookups run at the same time.

METADATA_IDENTITY_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long identity lookup results are cached, in seconds.

METADATA_IDENTITY_MIN_SCORE.description: Lowest title score (0–1) for a provider result to count as the same work.

METADATA_IDENTITY_DESCRIPTION_THRESHOLD.description: Lowest summary similarity (0–1) used as supporting identity evidence.

METADATA_IDENTITY_QUERY_LIMIT.description: Most title variants searched per identity lookup.

METADATA_IDENTITY_RESULTS_PER_PROVIDER.description: Most results read from each provider per search.

METADATA_IDENTITY_ON_INGEST.description: Look up the identity of new entries when they are first added.

METADATA_IDENTITY_ENTRIES_PER_FEED.description: Most new entries per source feed that get an identity lookup.

HTTP_MAX_CONNECTIONS.description: Most open outgoing HTTP connections in total.

HTTP_MAX_KEEPALIVE_CONNECTIONS.description: Most idle outgoing HTTP connections kept open for reuse.

HTTP_KEEPALIVE_EXPIRY_SECONDS.description: How long an idle outgoing connection is kept open, in seconds.

HTTP_TRANSPORT_RETRIES.description: How often a request is retried after a connection error (not after an HTTP error).

FEDERATED_SOURCE_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit per source when browsing or searching several sources, in seconds.

FEDERATED_ITEMS_PER_SOURCE.description: Most results taken from each source in a combined browse or search.

INTERACTIVE_SOURCE_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit per source for requests you are waiting on in the UI, in seconds.

INTERACTIVE_OVERALL_TIMEOUT.description: Total time limit for an interactive multi-source request, in seconds.

SEARCH_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long search results are reused, in seconds.

SEARCH_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES.description: Most search results kept in memory.

SUBBED_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long the subscribed-library view is reused, in seconds.

COVER_HINT_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES.description: Most cover addresses remembered in memory.

BROWSE_CACHE_REFRESH_SECONDS.description: Age after which a saved browse page is refreshed in the background, in seconds.

BROWSE_PREFETCH_PAGES.description: How many following browse pages are loaded ahead.

BACKGROUND_REFRESH_ON_STARTUP.description: Refresh source feeds shortly after start.

CONTINUOUS_CATALOG_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Pause between background catalogue feed requests, in seconds.

CONTINUOUS_CATALOG_MODES.description: Feeds the background catalogue reads: LATEST, POPULAR or both, comma-separated.

CONTINUOUS_CATALOG_BACKLOG_LIMIT.description: Most feed pages waiting in the background catalogue queue.

STARTUP_REFRESH_DELAY_SECONDS.description: Wait after start before the first background refresh, in seconds.

BACKGROUND_DEDUP_ON_STARTUP.description: Check for duplicate entries shortly after start.

AUTOMATIC_DUPLICATE_MATCHING_DELAY_SECON.description: Wait before automatic duplicate matching runs after a change, in seconds.

DUPLICATE_SIGNATURE_MAX_BUCKET.description: Largest group of similar titles compared in one duplicate check.

DUPLICATE_SNAPSHOT_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long the duplicate list is reused before it is rebuilt, in seconds.

DUPLICATE_AUTO_MERGE_MIN_EXACT_TITLES.description: Exact title matches needed before two entries can merge automatically.

DUPLICATE_AUTO_MERGE_SUMMARY_THRESHOLD.description: Lowest summary similarity (0–1) for an automatic merge.

DUPLICATE_AUTO_MERGE_MIN_SUMMARY_CHARS.description: Shortest summary, in characters, that counts as merge evidence.

EXACT_THUMBNAIL_MATCHING.description: Use identical cover images as matching evidence.

THUMBNAIL_FINGERPRINT_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long a cover fingerprint is kept, in seconds.

THUMBNAIL_FINGERPRINT_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit for downloading a cover to fingerprint it, in seconds.

THUMBNAIL_FINGERPRINT_ENTRIES_PER_PASS.description: Most entries fingerprinted per background pass.

REFRESH_SOURCE_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit per source when refreshing an entry, in seconds.

REFRESH_OVERALL_TIMEOUT.description: Total time limit for refreshing one entry, in seconds.

COVER_FETCH_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit for downloading a cover, in seconds.

COVER_INLINE_WAIT.description: How long a page waits for a cover before showing a placeholder, in seconds.

COVER_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long a downloaded cover is kept before it is checked again, in seconds.

COVER_FETCH_CONCURRENCY.description: How many covers are downloaded at the same time.

METADATA_ENRICHMENT_ENTRIES_PER_FEED.description: Most entries per feed that get extra metadata in the background.

METADATA_ENRICHMENT_CONCURRENCY.description: How many metadata lookups run at the same time.

METADATA_ENRICHMENT_SOURCE_LIMIT.description: Most sources asked for details of one entry.

METADATA_ENRICHMENT_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit for one metadata lookup, in seconds.

METADATA_ENRICHMENT_ON_STARTUP.description: Fill in missing metadata shortly after start.

METADATA_ENRICHMENT_STARTUP_DELAY_SECOND.description: Wait after start before the metadata pass, in seconds.

METADATA_ENRICHMENT_STARTUP_LIMIT.description: Most entries handled by the start-up metadata pass.

CHAPTER_PAGE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.description: How long a chapter's page list is reused, in seconds.

PAGE_INFO_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES.description: Most page lists kept in memory.

QUALITY_SAMPLE_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit for downloading one sample page for the quality score, in seconds.

QUALITY_OVERALL_TIMEOUT.description: Total time limit for scoring one chapter, in seconds.

COLOR_DETECTION_SAMPLE_PAGES.description: Pages sampled to decide whether a chapter is in colour.

COLOR_DETECTION_COLORED_PIXEL_FRACTION.description: Share of coloured pixels (0–1) above which a page counts as colour.

COLOR_DETECTION_MIN_CONFIDENCE.description: Lowest confidence (0–1) needed to label a source colour or black-and-white.

COLOR_DETECTION_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit for the colour check of one chapter, in seconds.

MANUAL_SEARCH_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit per source for a manual match search, in seconds.

MANUAL_SEARCH_OVERALL_TIMEOUT.description: Total time limit for a manual match search, in seconds.

MANUAL_SEARCH_ALIAS_LIMIT.description: Most alternative titles tried in a manual search.

MANUAL_SEARCH_LIVE_QUERY_LIMIT.description: Most live source queries per manual search.

AUTO_MISSING_SOURCE_ENTRIES_PER_FEED.description: Most entries per feed checked for sources they are still missing.

AUTO_MISSING_SOURCE_SOURCE_LIMIT.description: Most sources searched per entry for a missing source.

SOURCE_RECOVERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Time budget for recovering one slow source or item; finished work is kept and the rest stays retryable.

SUBBED_SEARCH_ENTRY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Time limit for searching sources for one subscribed entry, in seconds.

AUTO_VARIANT_DISCOVERY.description: Look for the same work on other sources in the background.

AUTO_VARIANT_MIN_SCORE.description: Lowest title score (0–1) for attaching another source's record automatically.

AUTO_VARIANT_QUERY_LIMIT.description: Most title variants searched per entry when looking for other sources.

AUTO_VARIANT_ENTRIES_PER_FEED.description: Most entries per feed checked for records on other sources.

AUTO_VARIANT_SOURCE_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit per source when looking for other records, in seconds.

AUTO_VARIANT_OVERALL_TIMEOUT.description: Total time limit per entry when looking for other records, in seconds.

AUTO_VARIANT_STARTUP_ENTRIES.description: Entries checked for other records shortly after start (0 = none).

AUTO_VARIANT_STARTUP_DELAY_SECONDS.description: Wait after start before that check, in seconds.

MANUAL_TRANSLATION_QUERY_LIMIT.description: Most translated titles searched in a manual search.

MANUAL_TRANSLATE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT.description: Most search results translated for comparison in a manual search.

TRANSLATION_TIMEOUT.description: Time limit for one translation request, in seconds.

TRANSLATION_OVERALL_TIMEOUT.description: Total time limit for translating one entry's titles, in seconds.

TRANSLATION_CONCURRENCY.description: How many translation requests run at the same time.

BACKGROUND_TRANSLATION_ON_DISCOVERY.description: Translate titles of newly found entries in the background.

BACKGROUND_TRANSLATION_ENTRIES_PER_FEED.description: Most new entries per feed translated in the background.

BACKGROUND_TRANSLATION_ENTRIES_PER_START.description: Entries translated shortly after start (0 = none).

TRANSLATION_STARTUP_DELAY_SECONDS.description: Wait after start before the translation pass, in seconds.

SOURCE_FAILURE_THRESHOLD.description: Failures in a row after which a source pauses.

SOURCE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.description: How long a failing source pauses, in seconds.

BACKGROUND_IDLE_SECONDS.description: Quiet time after your last action before background work resumes, in seconds.

SQLITE_CACHE_MB.description: Memory SQLite may use as page cache, in MB.

SQLITE_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS.description: How long a database write waits for a lock before failing, in milliseconds.

AUTH_METHOD.description: How people sign in: forms (login page, the default), basic (the browser's sign-in pop-up) or external (a sign-in proxy such as Authelia sends the user name and groups in headers). API keys and the admin token work with every method.

AUTH_ADMIN_GROUPS.description: External sign-in: comma-separated provider groups whose members get the admin role (for example admins). Groups never make someone the owner.

AUTH_GUEST_GROUPS.description: External sign-in: comma-separated provider groups whose members get the read-only guest role. Leave empty to refuse users who are in no admin group.

AUTH_OWNER_EXTERNAL_USER.description: External sign-in: the provider user name bound as owner on first boot. Only this account can become owner; group mappings never can.

AUTH_RESET_OWNER.description: Last-resort owner reset: set to true in Compose for one start when the owner has lost the password and every recovery code. The next start clears the owner's password (data is kept), the login page asks for a new one, and the event is logged. Remove it afterwards.
